image_description: A fully assembled black AR-15 style assault rifle lying on a yellow cloth surface. The rifle features a mounted optical scope, a handguard with a rail system, and an inserted magazine. To the right of the rifle, there are disassembled components including a silver bolt carrier group, a recoil spring, and a printed instruction card. The background includes a tan bag and green fabric.
